description: Land Acquisition - Henegama, Akuressa D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lots A-H) with their boundaries, extents, and locations in Matara District. The document serves as an official declaration that these lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions the Minister of Lands making the declaration, this is incidental to the core land acquisition content and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification type.
